blocks.zh: 第零節：簡介、目的與適用範圍
blocks.en: Section 0: Introduction, Purpose and Scope

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解 PIC/S PE 011-1 的起源與法律地位 — 它是指引 (guidance) 而非強制性規範，但各 PIC/S 成員國主管機關可將其轉化為具法律約束力的標準
blocks.en: Understand the origin and legal status of PIC/S PE 011-1: it is guidance, not a mandatory rule, but the competent authorities of PIC/S member countries may convert it into legally binding standards

blocks.zh: 掌握 Good Distribution Practice (GDP) 的核心定義：wholesale distribution 涵蓋哪些活動，不涵蓋哪些
blocks.en: Grasp the core definition of Good Distribution Practice (GDP): which activities wholesale distribution covers and which it does not

blocks.zh: 理解 GDP 對 CDMO 的直接意義 — 製造廠若自行配送產品，必須同時符合 GMP 與 GDP
blocks.en: Understand what GDP means directly for a CDMO: a manufacturer that distributes its own products must comply with both GMP and GDP

blocks.zh: 明確 GDP 的目的：維護藥品完整性、防止假藥進入合法供應鏈，並促進批發許可制度的一致性
blocks.en: Be clear on the purpose of GDP: to maintain the integrity of medicinal products, keep falsified medicines out of the legitimate supply chain, and promote consistency in wholesale licensing systems

blocks.zh: 界定本指引的適用範圍 — 人用藥品為主，獸藥與試驗用藥品 (IMP) 亦建議參考適用
blocks.en: Define the scope of this guide: it applies mainly to medicinal products for human use, and it is also recommended for veterinary medicinal products and investigational medicinal products (IMPs)

blocks.zh: Document History — 文件歷程
blocks.en: Document History

blocks.zh: Introduction — 簡介
blocks.en: Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：GDP 的法律定位與 CDMO 的責任
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Legal Status of GDP and the CDMO's Responsibility

blocks.zh: EU GDP vs. PIC/S PE 011-1： 本指引根植於歐盟 GDP 指引 (2013/C 343/01)，但刪除了歐盟特有的條款，使其適用於所有 PIC/S 參與國（包含台灣 TFDA 管轄範圍）。理解這個「轉換」很重要：PIC/S 版本是歐盟精神的移植，核心要求一致，但執行細節由各國主管機關決定。
blocks.en: EU GDP vs. PIC/S PE 011-1: This guide is rooted in the EU GDP Guidelines (2013/C 343/01), but EU-specific provisions have been removed so that it can apply to all PIC/S participating authorities (including Taiwan, under TFDA jurisdiction). It helps to understand this "translation": the PIC/S version carries over the spirit of the EU guidelines and the core requirements are the same, but implementation details are left to each national competent authority.

blocks.zh: Guidance vs. Legally Binding： PE 011-1 本身是「指引」，不是「法規」。但 TFDA 可以將其內容納入台灣的法規要求。實務上，查廠時若被要求說明 GDP 符合情形，這份文件就是稽查員的參考框架。
blocks.en: Guidance vs. Legally Binding: PE 011-1 is itself "guidance", not a "regulation". However, TFDA may incorporate its content into Taiwan's regulatory requirements. In practice, if you are asked during an inspection to explain how you comply with GDP, this document is the inspector's frame of reference.

blocks.zh: 製造商的 GDP 義務： 關鍵點 — 持有製造許可的廠商，只要對自家產品從事任何配送活動（包含出廠、轉移、出口），就必須同時遵守 GDP。對台灣 CDMO 而言，這代表從成品放行後到交付給客戶的整段物流鏈，都在 GDP 範疇內。
blocks.en: The manufacturer's GDP obligations: The key point is that a holder of a manufacturing authorisation must comply with GDP whenever it carries out any distribution activity for its own products (including release from the site, transfers and export). For a Taiwanese CDMO, this means the entire logistics chain, from release of the finished product to delivery to the customer, falls within the scope of GDP.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像一家餐廳（CDMO）製作了精緻料理（藥品）。GMP 規範的是廚房裡的製作過程；GDP 規範的是料理從廚房出發、送到客人手上這段旅程。哪怕這道菜在廚房做得完美無缺，如果外送過程溫度失控或被掉包（假藥混入），最終到達客人手上的就不再是同一道菜了。
blocks.en: Imagine a restaurant (the CDMO) that prepares an exquisite dish (the medicinal product). GMP governs how the dish is made in the kitchen; GDP governs the journey from the kitchen to the customer's hands. Even if the dish was made flawlessly, if the temperature runs out of control during delivery, or the dish is swapped (falsified product enters the chain), what finally reaches the customer is no longer the same dish.

blocks.zh: GDP 就是確保這段「最後一哩路」的品質管控機制。對 CDMO 來說，GMP 是核心能力，但 GDP 是讓這份核心能力不被「交付過程」抵消的保障。
blocks.en: GDP is the quality control mechanism for this "last mile". For a CDMO, GMP is the core competence, but GDP is what keeps that core competence from being undone during delivery.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Note
blocks.en: Key Note

blocks.zh: 自由貿易區（Free Zone）不免責： 文件明確指出，在自由貿易區或保稅倉庫從事藥品配送的業者，同樣受 GDP 規範。對於台灣 CDMO 若有產品進出加工出口區或保稅廠區，這一點尤其值得注意。
blocks.en: Free zones are not exempt: The document states explicitly that operators distributing medicinal products in free zones or bonded warehouses are also subject to GDP. This deserves particular attention if a Taiwanese CDMO moves products in and out of export processing zones or bonded areas.

blocks.zh: Wholesale distribution 的定義邊界： 「對公眾直接供應」不屬於批發配送，因此藥局最後一哩的零售行為不在本指引範圍。但 CDMO 的客戶是藥廠或其他批發商，整條鏈都在 GDP 涵蓋之下。
blocks.en: The boundary of the definition of wholesale distribution: "Supplying directly to the public" is not wholesale distribution, so retail activity at the pharmacy (the last mile) is outside the scope of this guide. A CDMO's customers, however, are pharmaceutical manufacturers or other wholesalers, so the whole chain falls under GDP.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 假設你的 CDMO 完成一批無菌注射劑的充填封裝後，由公司自有冷藏車將產品運送至客戶位於新竹的倉庫，再由客戶安排出口。
blocks.en: Suppose your CDMO finishes filling and packaging a batch of sterile injectables, and then delivers the product in the company's own refrigerated truck to the customer's warehouse in Hsinchu, from where the customer arranges export.

blocks.zh: 根據本節，你的公司持有製造許可且自行執行了配送活動，因此必須確認：(1) 公司是否已取得批發配送許可或符合相關豁免條件；(2) 冷藏車的溫度監控與記錄是否符合 GDP 要求；(3) 交接文件是否完整，能追溯整條配送鏈的責任歸屬。
blocks.en: Under this section, your company holds a manufacturing authorisation and carries out the distribution itself, so you must confirm: (1) whether the company has obtained a wholesale distribution authorisation or qualifies for a relevant exemption; (2) whether temperature monitoring and records for the refrigerated truck meet GDP requirements; (3) whether the handover documents are complete enough to trace responsibility along the whole distribution chain.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 台灣的 CDMO 若同時持有 GMP 製造許可，是否自動具有批發配送資格？需要額外申請什麼許可？
blocks.en: If a Taiwanese CDMO holds a GMP manufacturing licence, does it automatically qualify to carry out wholesale distribution? What additional licence is needed?

blocks.zh: 客戶委託第三方物流（3PL）從 CDMO 廠區將成品運走，CDMO 是否仍需對這段物流承擔 GDP 責任？責任如何分配？
blocks.en: If a customer appoints a third-party logistics provider (3PL) to collect finished product from the CDMO site, does the CDMO still bear GDP responsibility for that transport? How is responsibility allocated?

blocks.zh: 「Annex 1（詞彙表）」列於本指引末尾，作為學習者你應該在何時去查閱它？
blocks.en: "Annex 1 (Glossary)" appears at the end of this guide. When should you, as a learner, consult it?

blocks.zh: Purpose — 目的
blocks.en: Purpose

blocks.zh: 核心概念：GDP 的三大目的
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Three Purposes of GDP

blocks.zh: 本節開宗明義說明 GDP 的設立有三個並行目標：
blocks.en: This section opens by stating that GDP has three parallel aims:

blocks.zh: 品質保證與完整性 (Quality Assurance & Integrity)： 確保藥品從製造商到下游客戶的整個配送過程中，品質不被破壞。
blocks.en: Quality Assurance & Integrity: Ensure that the quality of medicinal products is not compromised throughout the distribution process, from the manufacturer to downstream customers.

blocks.zh: 許可制度一致性 (Uniformity in Licensing)： 讓各國批發許可制度趨於一致，降低跨國貿易的法規摩擦。
blocks.en: Uniformity in Licensing: Bring wholesale licensing systems in different countries closer together, reducing regulatory friction in cross-border trade.

blocks.zh: 貿易壁壘的消除 (Remove Barriers to Trade)： 通過標準化提高市場互認程度。
blocks.en: Remove Barriers to Trade: Increase mutual recognition between markets through standardisation.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的意義： 你的客戶可能來自多個國家，他們的下游監管機構也會要求產品的配送符合 GDP。了解 GDP 的目的，有助於在客戶審廠時清楚說明你的配送管理體系。
blocks.en: What this means for a CDMO: Your customers may come from many countries, and their downstream regulators will also require that distribution of the product complies with GDP. Understanding the purpose of GDP helps you explain your distribution management system clearly during customer audits.

blocks.zh: GDP 就像「道路規則」中的高速公路標準。不同國家的高速公路設計可能有細微差異（車道寬、限速），但核心安全標準（護欄高度、緊急出口間距）是一致的。PIC/S GDP 就是那個讓各國「高速公路品質」彼此互信的共同標準。
blocks.en: GDP is like the motorway standard in the "rules of the road". Motorways in different countries may differ in small details (lane width, speed limits), but the core safety standards (guardrail height, spacing of emergency exits) are the same. PIC/S GDP is the common standard that lets countries trust each other's "motorway quality".

blocks.zh: 值得注意的是：文件說「有其他可接受方法」。這代表 GDP 是結果導向的，不是死板的清單。你可以創新，只要能達到相同的品質保證結果，並且能向稽查員說明清楚。
blocks.en: Note that the document says "other acceptable methods" may be used. This means GDP is outcome-oriented, not a rigid checklist. You may innovate, as long as you achieve the same quality assurance outcome and can explain it clearly to the inspector.

blocks.zh: 「Acceptable methods」的實務意涵： 這句話給了企業彈性，但也帶來責任。若你採用非常規方法（例如以物聯網感測器取代傳統溫度記錄儀），你必須能夠：(1) 證明這個方法等效或優於傳統方法；(2) 在稽查中清楚呈現驗證資料。不能只說「我們有更好的方式」，要能拿出證據。
blocks.en: The practical implication of "acceptable methods": This wording gives companies flexibility, but it also brings responsibility. If you adopt an unconventional method (for example, IoT sensors in place of traditional temperature data loggers), you must be able to: (1) demonstrate that the method is equivalent or superior to the traditional one; (2) present the validation data clearly during an inspection. It is not enough to say "we have a better way"; you must bring evidence.

blocks.zh: 訓練目的的明示： 文件明確說這份指引可用於訓練目的，代表你在培訓記錄中直接引用 PE 011-1 的條款是合適且被鼓勵的。
blocks.en: Training purpose stated explicitly: The document states explicitly that this guide may be used for training purposes, so citing PE 011-1 clauses directly in your training records is appropriate and encouraged.

blocks.zh: 若 TFDA 發佈了比 PE 011-1 更嚴格的本國 GDP 規定，廠商應依循哪一份文件？GDP 的「最低標準」邏輯在此如何應用？
blocks.en: If TFDA issues national GDP requirements that are stricter than PE 011-1, which document should the company follow? How does the "minimum standard" logic of GDP apply here?

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 想用即時電子溫度監控系統取代傳統的溫度記錄儀，在 GDP 框架下，你需要準備哪些文件來支持這個決定？
blocks.en: Your CDMO wants to replace traditional temperature data loggers with a real-time electronic temperature monitoring system. Under the GDP framework, what documents do you need to prepare to support this decision?

blocks.zh: Scope — 適用範圍
blocks.en: Scope

blocks.zh: 核心概念：適用範圍的三個層次
blocks.en: Core Concept: Three Levels of Applicability

blocks.zh: 強制適用 (Mandatory)： 人用藥品 (medicinal products for human use) — 這是本指引的核心對象。
blocks.en: Mandatory: Medicinal products for human use. This is the core target of the guide.

blocks.zh: 建議適用 (Recommended)： 獸藥 (veterinary medicinal products) — 文件用「recommended」而非「shall」，代表屬於最佳實踐建議。
blocks.en: Recommended: Veterinary medicinal products. The document uses "recommended" rather than "shall", which makes this a best-practice recommendation.

blocks.zh: 亦可適用 (Also applicable)： 試驗用藥品 IMP — 臨床試驗中使用的藥品，GDP 同樣適用。對於有承接臨床試驗批次充填業務的 CDMO，這一點尤其重要，因為 IMP 的物流管控往往比商業批次更嚴格（需要盲化、隨機化等額外要求）。
blocks.en: Also applicable: Investigational medicinal products (IMPs). GDP applies equally to medicinal products used in clinical trials. This matters particularly for a CDMO that takes on clinical trial batch filling, because logistics control for IMPs is often stricter than for commercial batches (additional requirements such as blinding and randomisation).

blocks.zh: 想像一本《食品安全法》：明確規範餐廳（人用藥品），建議寵物飼料廠也參考（獸藥），且同樣適用於實驗室開發中的新食品配方（IMP）。
blocks.en: Think of a "Food Safety Act": it clearly regulates restaurants (medicinal products for human use), recommends that pet food manufacturers follow it too (veterinary medicines), and equally applies to new food formulations still under development in the laboratory (IMPs).

blocks.zh: 「不阻礙技術創新」這段話是 GDP 的開放性聲明。法規通常有追不上技術的問題，這段文字讓廠商有空間引入新科技（如區塊鏈追蹤、AI 溫度預測），前提是已完成驗證且能達到等效或更好的品質保證效果。
blocks.en: The statement that GDP should "not hinder technological innovation" is an open-ended declaration. Regulations often lag behind technology, and this wording gives companies room to introduce new technologies (such as blockchain tracking or AI temperature prediction), provided they have been validated and achieve equivalent or better quality assurance.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：IMP 的 GDP 特殊挑戰
blocks.en: Key Note: Special GDP Challenges for IMPs

blocks.zh: 試驗用藥品的配送比商業批次複雜，除 GDP 要求外，還需考量：
blocks.en: Distribution of investigational medicinal products is more complex than for commercial batches. In addition to GDP requirements, consider the following:

blocks.zh: 盲化 (Blinding)： 標籤設計不得洩漏隨機分配結果，物流人員需接受特殊訓練
blocks.en: Blinding: Label design must not reveal the randomisation allocation, and logistics staff need special training

blocks.zh: 追蹤到患者層級： IMP 通常需要記錄到每個患者接收的批次和數量
blocks.en: Traceability to patient level: IMPs usually require records down to the batch and quantity received by each patient

blocks.zh: 溫度偏差的影響評估： 對於 IMP，任何溫度偏差都可能影響試驗結果的有效性，不只是產品品質
blocks.en: Impact assessment of temperature excursions: For IMPs, any temperature excursion may affect the validity of the trial results, not just product quality

blocks.zh: 退回藥品 (Return) 的管理： IMP 的退回品通常不得再使用，需要嚴格的隔離與銷毀程序
blocks.en: Management of returned medicines: Returned IMPs generally may not be reused and require strict segregation and destruction procedures

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 正在爭取一個 Phase II 臨床試驗的無菌充填案。客戶要求你同時負責成品的低溫倉儲（2–8°C）及台灣境內到各臨床試驗中心的配送。
blocks.en: Your CDMO is bidding for a Phase II clinical trial sterile filling project. The customer asks you to take charge of both cold storage of the finished product (2–8°C) and distribution within Taiwan to the clinical trial sites.

blocks.zh: 在準備客戶審廠 (client audit) 時，你需要展示：(1) GDP 合規的倉儲管理 SOP；(2) 冷鏈驗證報告（包含配送路線的溫度 mapping）；(3) 溫度偏差的調查與產品評估程序；(4) IMP 特有的退回品管理 SOP。本指引的「IMP 亦適用」條款，正是你引用的法規依據。
blocks.en: When preparing for the client audit, you need to show: (1) a GDP-compliant warehouse management SOP; (2) a cold chain validation report (including temperature mapping of the distribution routes); (3) procedures for investigating temperature excursions and assessing the product; (4) an SOP for managing returned product specific to IMPs. The clause stating that the guide also applies to IMPs is the regulatory basis you cite.

blocks.zh: 本指引說「不阻礙技術創新」，若你的公司想導入 IoT 傳感器做全程即時溫度監控來取代傳統資料記錄器，你需要完成哪些驗證才能說這個方法「至少等效」？
blocks.en: This guide says it should "not hinder technological innovation". If your company wants to introduce IoT sensors for real-time temperature monitoring throughout transport in place of traditional data loggers, what validation must you complete before you can say the method is "at least equivalent"?

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 客戶既有商業批次產品，也有 IMP 產品，兩類產品都在同一倉庫存放。你需要在 SOP 或倉庫設計上做哪些區隔？
blocks.en: Your CDMO's customer has both commercial products and IMPs, and both are stored in the same warehouse. What segregation do you need to build into the SOPs or the warehouse design?

blocks.zh: 2014 年版 PE 011-1 距今已超過十年。在冷鏈技術、數位化追蹤方面有哪些現代工具是當時未預見的？這些工具如何在「已驗證且等效」的原則下被納入 GDP 合規？
blocks.en: The 2014 edition of PE 011-1 is now more than ten years old. What modern tools in cold chain technology and digital tracking were not foreseen at the time? How can these tools be brought into GDP compliance under the principle of "validated and equivalent"?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 來源與地位： PE 011-1 根植於歐盟 GDP 指引 (2013/C 343/01)，由 PIC/S 採納為指引文件，各成員國主管機關可決定是否將其轉為具法律約束力的標準
blocks.en: Origin and status: PE 011-1 is rooted in the EU GDP Guidelines (2013/C 343/01) and was adopted by PIC/S as a guidance document; the competent authority of each member country decides whether to convert it into a legally binding standard

blocks.zh: 核心定義： Wholesale distribution 涵蓋採購、持有、供應、進口、出口，但不包含對公眾直接供應。持有製造許可的廠商若自行配送產品，亦必須遵守 GDP
blocks.en: Core definition: Wholesale distribution covers procuring, holding, supplying, importing and exporting, but not supplying directly to the public. A manufacturing authorisation holder that distributes its own products must also comply with GDP

blocks.zh: 三大目的： 維護品質保證與配送完整性 / 促進批發許可制度一致性 / 消除藥品貿易壁壘
blocks.en: Three purposes: maintain quality assurance and distribution integrity / promote uniformity of wholesale licensing systems / remove barriers to trade in medicinal products

blocks.zh: 適用範圍： 人用藥品（強制）；獸藥（建議）；IMP 試驗用藥品（亦適用）
blocks.en: Scope: medicinal products for human use (mandatory); veterinary medicinal products (recommended); IMPs (also applicable)

blocks.zh: 創新開放性： GDP 不阻礙技術創新，允許採用非傳統方法，但必須經過驗證且達到等效或更高的品質保證水準
blocks.en: Openness to innovation: GDP does not hinder technological innovation and allows non-traditional methods, provided they are validated and achieve an equivalent or higher level of quality assurance

blocks.zh: CDMO 關鍵點： 從成品放行到交付客戶的整段物流鏈都在 GDP 管轄之下；承接 IMP 充填業務時，GDP 合規是基本門檻
blocks.en: Key points for a CDMO: The entire logistics chain from release of the finished product to delivery to the customer falls under GDP; when taking on IMP filling work, GDP compliance is a basic entry requirement
